brief: A podcast player where episodes are constellations — listened ones glow, series form patterns

dominant_strengths: Strong metaphor execution: amber/orange glow against deep navy evokes a real night sky and rewards listening
Distinctive concept — constellations as series with playing/listened/unplayed states gives instant emotional hook
Player bar is well-crafted with cohesive gradient artwork, clear hierarchy, and warm progress fill matching stars
dominant_weaknesses: Behavioral usability is weak: tiny star targets, no episode metadata, unclear how to browse, select, or queue
Constellation 'lines' are barely visible — patterns the brief promises don't actually read as connected shapes
Label typography floats inconsistently near nodes, and series names compete with similarly-styled state legend
fix_priorities: Strengthen constellation linework with subtle gradient strokes so series patterns are legible at a glance
Add hover/focus state with episode title, duration, and play affordance to fix discoverability
Establish typographic hierarchy distinguishing series labels, episode titles, and UI legend
Cluster star groupings with more deliberate spatial rhythm to avoid random-scatter perception
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral and reflective land beautifully through the cosmic metaphor, but behavioral usability lags far behind — it's a poster more than a player.
rationale.intent_fit: The constellation metaphor is delivered with genuine atmosphere, though weak connecting lines undermine the 'series form patterns' half of the brief.
